title: Online Inference in Distributional Temporal-Difference Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.14408v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study online statistical inference for functionals of the return distribution under a fixed policy. The return distribution is estimated by nonparametric distributional temporal-difference learning from a single Markov trajectory. For the Polyak--Ruppert averaged estimator, we prove that its root-$T$ error converges weakly to a centered Gaussian random element in Cram\'er space. We also prove that, conditionally on the observed trajectory, the root-$T$ difference between the bootstrap and original averages converges weakly to the same Gaussian limit. These results justify bootstrap inference for smooth statistical functionals, including variance, CVaR, expected shortfall, and expectiles. For nonsmooth statistical functionals, we develop a local asymptotic theory for the estimated return CDF over $T^{-1/2}$-neighborhoods of finitely many thresholds, together with its bootstrap analogue. translated_title: 分布时序差分学习中的在线推断
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在固定策略下，针对回报分布泛函的在线统计推断问题。回报分布通过非参数分布时序差分学习从单一马尔可夫轨迹中估计。对于Polyak-Ruppert平均估计器，我们证明了其根号T误差在Cramér空间中弱收敛于中心高斯随机元素。我们还证明了，在观测轨迹的条件下，自助法与原始平均值之间的根号T差异弱收敛于相同的高斯极限。这些结果证明了对于光滑统计泛函（包括方差、CVaR、期望短缺和期望分位数）的自助推断是合理的。对于非光滑统计泛函，我们开发了在有限多个阈值的$T^{-1/2}$邻域内估计回报CDF的局部渐近理论，以及其自助对应版本。该理论使我们能够进行推断。
tldr: 本文为分布时序差分学习提供了在线推断的理论框架，证明了平均估计器和自助法的渐近正态性，并扩展到了非光滑泛函的局部推断。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a theoretical framework for online inference in distributional temporal-difference learning, proving asymptotic normality of averaged estimators and bootstrap, and extending to local inference for nonsmooth functionals.
